annotations.title: Book search, find books by title or author

description: Search books by title, author or any words: up to 20 works with title, authors, first publish year, edition count, ISBNs (up to 5), publishers, languages, cover image and Open Library link, from Open Library's catalogue (CC0). Filter by author or title alone if you like. Use to find a book's ISBN, an author's works or editions before an ISBN lookup. Example: q=dune frank herbert. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
